title: Actual RibaMod passive groundwater transfer under frozen daily UserDemand allocation

sequencing.rationale: Freeze the first active physical-transfer experiment before the preceding product clock qualifications are observed.

authorities.product_release: DUMMY-20B qualified Ribasim v2026.1.1 clock contract

modflow.mapping: single passive Drainage bound index 0 -> Ribasim Basin index 0

independent_continuous_reference.final_ledger: 32 m3 fixed surface supply + 8 m3 groundwater drainage = root supplied + Basin storage gain

hypotheses: The real MF6 passive drain exports approximately 8 m3/day from the fixed-head cell and RibaMod presents the reciprocal positive drainage input to the Ribasim Basin.
The physical groundwater transfer acts immediately on Basin storage during each 6-hour product step.
The daily UserDemand allocation is not recomputed merely because extra physical groundwater water arrives after the t=0 allocation.
External-demand cumulative supply remains zero throughout day 1.
Root cumulative supply and Basin level follow the frozen continuous reference within tolerance.
The reciprocal one-day ledger closes: 32 m3 fixed source + 8 m3 groundwater transfer = root physical supply + Basin storage gain.
Thus physical hydrology can alter accepted state without being retrospectively converted into a different management allocation inside the current allocation window.
forbidden: no reallocation within day to force use of the groundwater transfer
no inference to SWAP irrigation production semantics
no active river-stage feedback in this first transfer test
no later f965 clock semantics as product-release truth
no changing references or transfer magnitude after upstream runtime output
